articles.headline: Pelé's 1958 World Cup final jersey sells for $4.9M at auction
articles.description: The jersey Pelé wore during Brazil's 5-2 victory over Sweden in the 1958 FIFA World Cup final sold at Sotheby's for $4.88 million on Thursday.
